crossRefs.note: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

translations.web: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
translations.bsb: The intentions of a man’s heart are deep waters, but a man of understanding draws them out.
translations.kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
translations.asv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; But a man of understanding will draw it out.
